# Compounding Knowledge Architecture

An **ever-evolving knowledge base** achieves compounding returns only when every new source and every insightful conversation strengthens existing structures instead of scattering isolated notes.

## The Four Pillars

1. **Persistent Compilation ([[llm-wiki-pattern|LLM Wiki Pattern]])**: Move synthesis upstream from query time to ingest time, contrasting sharply with [[rag-vs-compiled-wiki|RAG vs Compiled Wiki]].
2. **Similarity-First Updating ([[entity-deduplication-and-merging|Entity Deduplication and Merging]])**: Always search existing pages before creating a new one; merge updates in-place with revision history and contradiction tracking.
3. **Autonomous Maintenance ([[self-maintaining-knowledge-graphs|Self-Maintaining Knowledge Graphs]])**: Continuously weave unlinked mentions, integrate orphans, and resolve dangling links so graph density increases safely.
4. **Closed-Loop Exploration**: Grounded chat queries consult `index.md` + hybrid search and file valuable answers back into the wiki, realizing [[vannevar-bush-memex|Vannevar Bush Memex]] trails in a local Markdown workspace like [[obsidian-markdown-ide|Obsidian Markdown IDE]].
